data_and_folds: identical to frozen E3.0; 419 tasks, five models, three repeats, shared 5-fold OOF
predictor: unchanged E3.0 fold-local TF-IDF plus Ridge component predictor

quality_constrained.rule: among models with Qhat >= max(Qhat)-tau, select highest predicted cost efficiency
quality_constrained.selection: report every frozen operating point; do not select tau from these outcomes

tchebycheff: Pareto-filter predicted (Q,Ceff), then minimize max(0.7 normalized quality shortfall, 0.3 normalized cost-efficiency shortfall)
oracle: ex-post quality-constrained cheapest model at each frozen tau; upper bound only
uncertainty: 10000 paired task bootstraps for quality and cost deltas
stop_rule: If all deployable quality-constrained points with nonnegative mean quality delta save less than 5% cost, stop dual-method expansion and retain the negative result.
